title: The owed-bind tick's credential rebind starts Engram calls after the tick's 20-second budget is spent
outcome: The owed-bind tick's credential rebind (rebind_engram_session_for_owed_binds) runs within the tick's remaining Engram-call budget. It receives the tick deadline and is deferred to a later tick once that budget is spent, so session_status and session_bind never start after the budget the docs promise (at most 20 seconds of Engram calls per tick). A regression test covers a credential refusal that arrives at the deadline edge. Today the rebind calls bind_engram_target_uncoordinated_off_lock, which starts a fresh recovery budget (engram_host_adapter.rs ~7733), delaying the single owed-binds worker during slow recovery.
acceptance: The owed-bind tick's credential rebind starts Engram calls after the tick's 20-second budget is spent is done
